principle_violations.reason: UserService depends directly on the concrete implementation MySQLDatabase, which violates the Dependency Inversion Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce an interface for database operations and let MySQLDatabase implement it. Make UserService depend on the interface instead of the concrete implementation.

principle_violations.reason: Any changes to database implementation require modifications to the MySQLDatabase class.
principle_violations.suggestion: Utilize an interface for database operations to allow adding new database implementations without altering existing code.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details above.
